newsitem.title: INDIA: India's RBI sets 14-day t-bill cut-off at 99.81.
newsitem.headline: India's RBI sets 14-day t-bill cut-off at 99.81.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Friday it had set the cut-off rate at 99.81 rupees at its 14-day t-bill auction.
The yield works out to 4.96 percent, unchanged from the previous auction.

The RBI said it received two competitive bids amounting to 1.01 billion rupees and one non-competitive bid for 500 million rupees. It said it accepted one competitive bid worth one billion, and the non-competitive bid.
The RBI said the total face-value for the t-bills was 1.5 billion rupees.
The weighted average works out to 99.81 rupees.
